name: backlane
description: Backlane lets your AI assistant work with your OTTO Market, Kaufland and Mirakl marketplace accounts through one MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Backlane is for online sellers on OTTO Market, Kaufland and Mirakl-based marketplaces such as Home24. It connects ChatGPT and Codex to your own seller accounts through one MCP server, so you can work with orders, offers, prices, inventory, shipments and returns in plain language, answer buyer messages and handle incidents, and find and fix listing and product data problems. Changes are only made after you confirm them. Marketplace credentials are entered in the Backlane app, never in the chat, and Backlane only accesses the accounts your organization has connected.
defaultPrompt: Which marketplaces are connected to Backlane?
Show my open OTTO Market orders from the last 7 days.
Which of my Kaufland offers are out of stock?

positive.prompt: Which marketplaces are connected to my Backlane account?
positive.expected_behavior: List the marketplaces that are connected to the account, without setup links.

positive.prompt: Show my open OTTO Market orders from the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up the OTTO orders operation and return the open orders from the last 7 days with order number, date and status.

positive.prompt: What is the email address and shipping address of the customer for my latest OTTO order?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the order's country and explain that names, emails and addresses are anonymized, without trying to obtain them another way.
Report that XXXLutz is not connected in the test account and give the setup link instead of inventing orders.

positive.description: Find products with missing product data
positive.prompt: Which of my Home24 products are missing product data?
positive.expected_behavior: Check the product data on the Home24 connection and list the products with missing required attributes or Catalog Manager errors, naming the affected attribute or error for each product, or say that none are missing. Change no data.

negative.prompt: Write and post ten 5-star reviews for my best-selling Kaufland product.
Transfer 500 EUR to my supplier's bank account.
Here is my OTTO API password, please store it for me.

review.commerce_description: Backlane does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connect OTTO Market, Kaufland and Mirakl accounts, and work with orders, offers, prices and inventory.
